list.a1: LIFE is a decentralized digital ecosystem based on blockchain technology, designed to provide users with a secure, private, and autonomous data management experience. It is not a financial tool in the traditional sense, but your personal data asset steward.
list.q2: What are LIFE points used for?
list.a2: LIFE points are proofs of rights within the ecosystem, used to reward users for data contributions (such as health data uploads). Points can be used to redeem ecosystem services and participate in community governance voting, but cannot be used for illegal trading.
list.q3: How is my data security guaranteed?
list.a3: We use military-grade AES-256 encryption technology. Your core data and private keys are stored only on your local device. Without your authorization, no one (including the platform) can view or access your data.

safety.title: Things You Need to Know
safety.subtitle: Security is the cornerstone of Web3. Please read the following guide carefully.

assets.title: Asset Security & Key Management
assets.line1: Private keys/mnemonics are the only credentials for assets. Lost ones cannot be recovered. Be sure to back them up offline on paper.
assets.line2: Never store private keys in networked environments like WeChat, email, or cloud drives.
assets.line3: The official team will NEVER ask for your private keys or mnemonic phrases.

scam.title: Prevent Scams & Phishing
scam.line1: Be wary of scams involving fake customer service, airdrops, and high rebates.
scam.line2: Be sure to download the wallet from the official website to prevent malware from stealing assets.
scam.line3: Check the source carefully before authorizing DApps and do not click on strange links.

tx.title: Transactions & Fees
tx.line1: Blockchain transfers are irreversible. Please verify the address before transferring.
tx.line2: Fees are charged by the blockchain network and are unrelated to the platform. Set Gas fees reasonably based on demand.
tx.line3: Some DApps may charge additional service fees. Please read instructions before operating.

compliance.title: Privacy & Compliance
compliance.line1: LIFE Wallet does not collect or store your personal data.
compliance.line2: Please comply with local laws and regulations when using digital assets.
compliance.line3: Some countries/regions have special regulatory policies on crypto assets. Please inform yourself.

support.title: FAQ & Support
support.line1: Assets will be permanently lost if you forget your mnemonic phrase; the official team cannot recover them.
support.line2: If you suspect your wallet is compromised, transfer remaining assets immediately and reset your device.
support.line3: For help, contact only via the official website or community. Be wary of fake customer service.
